title: Lewis and Clark Expedition
place: Camp Dubois (Illinois) up the Missouri River to Fort Clatsop (Oregon) on the Pacific coast
summary: An expedition crossed western North America to the Pacific coast and back, helped by the Shoshone interpreter Sacagawea.
why: Mapped the American West for the US government.

notes.problem: Sacagawea was interpreter, not guide; Pacific coast not US territory then
